meta.title: Org Talent Match
meta.description: Adds a "Talent match" entry to the left sidebar. The project guide shows the top requirement, multi-color project progress, stage outcomes and blocker/difficulty/change alert bar; the workspace turns a started project into member tasks with progress and status; the talent pool integrates every employee with current skills, availability and a profile drawer; Organization shows departments, teams, coverage and single-point skills; Team match evaluates team combinations across the organization on coverage, depth, availability, balance and synergy, and reports gaps, single-point dependencies and remaining team capacity. Every gap or single point gets a capability plan: skill upgrade, curated knowledge topics, or mentor-led training with a named learner and mentor. Each profile has a training planner: import skills from the skill center, randomise/remove them, and get a warning when the mix is not vertical depth. Skill research searches the skill center and public GitHub repositories and can add a result to the plan or profile. After matching, a project-team module records outcomes and adjustment feedback. Import employees from CSV, TSV, JSON, Markdown or XLSX by file or drag-and-drop; summary tiles open detail panels. Data stays in this browser; only the skill-search keyword is sent to GitHub, and no model is called.
